imagery.attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2025–2026), processed by ESA / Microsoft Planetary Computer; cloud-masked local composite

architecture.heightInference: OSM height/floors first; missing values use stable local height hints and coherent apartment-estate, landed-house or logistics estimates. Not surveyed heights.

modelNotes: Source footprint/contact geometry is retained. Repeated houses use shared estimated architectural templates, other ordinary buildings use shared mid-distance boxes and source-derived district proxies in the far distance. Heights/colours are source fields or deterministic estimates, not guaranteed surveys.
imagery: Cloud-masked Copernicus Sentinel-2 2025–2026 composite, native 10 m
selection: all eligible OSM footprints across the full 60 km terrain, including residential multipolygons/courtyards; airport, road and water exclusions; no cell sampling
colourMethod: Cloud-masked Sentinel-2 neighbourhood median (10 m source); vegetation/shadow rejection; estimated coherent Singapore estate facade palette
